text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended to be inconsistent with the City of Toronto Property Naming Policy. On March 26, 2018, a request was received to name the playground located in Lionel Conacher Park, 80 Cottingham Street, to honour Bill Davis. The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division has reviewed the Council-approved City of Toronto Property Naming Policy and found that this naming request is consistent with the policy criteria and process. The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division is recommending naming the playground located in Lionel Conacher Park, 80 Cottingham Street, to honour Bill Davis.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Named the playground located in Lionel Conacher Park, 80 Cottingham Street, the "Bill R. Davis Playground".
